thread:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to push the kernel + quant-profile slate this Friday during the 18:00 UTC window. Who's owning the deploy and smoke?
Alex: I can take lead on the rollout. Sam will be co-owner for rollback and canary checks.
Sam: +1. I'll run the canary slot and monitor perf dashboards.
Maya: Thanks — Alex/Sam, can you confirm checklist items and rollback hooks? Need an explicit ✅ before I reserve the window in calendar.
Alex: Checklist draft: 1) kibana smoke query + baseline, 2) small canary (5 slots) for 30m, 3) KV-cache warmup script, 4) post-deploy perf snapshot, 5) rollback runbook ready.
Nina: Add: backup model artifacts and pin quant profile id in config (so we can reapply previous profile easily).
Leo: Ops note — make sure autoscaler cooldown set to 10m for the window, otherwise we'll get scale churn.
Sam: Rollback hooks: we have `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-engine -n redwood` and the internal inv command: ``inv infra rollback --service=runtime --to-revision=$REV``. Also we keep a model-profile tag like `quant-v2-202603` to revert.
Alex: I'll prepare the smoke commands and paste them into the runbook. Quick snippet for smoke load (small):
```bash
./scripts/smoke_single_slot.sh --model slate-q2 --duration 300 --qps 5
# expects prometheus labels service=runtime, slot=test-canary
```
Maya: Nice. What's the fallback plan if latency regresses >30th percentile by >40%?
Sam: Immediate rollback. Also we have the routing policy to fall back to `slate-legacy` if healthcheck fails. I'll make sure the route is togglable from console.
Alex: I'll leave a pre-deploy checklist message in this thread 1h before the window with final runbook links.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Reserved calendar slot on 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC for eng-runtime deployment window (duration 45m). Owner: Alex.
Maya: Perfect. Last ask — can someone claim post-deploy postmortem owner (short blameless one-pager)?
Nina: I'll take postmortem and quick perf diff.
Leo: I'll handle infra note about scaling and cooldown.
Alex: I'll post the runbook link and CIDR for canary lanes ~30m before.
Maya: Great. If no blockers, I'll mark this as green and send the invite. :thumbsup:
Sam: :eyes: will be on pager during window.
Maya: Thanks all — feel free to ping here for last-minute syncs.
